title: Reader artifact provenance, native/raw versus neutral projection, and peer-route closure
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and local plan crosswalk
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Refresh the current published TNYCL/cadkit reader and DXF artifact evidence against its mutable repository documentation and provenance ledger
Separate native/raw DWG decode outcomes from neutral-model projection and DXF writer outcomes
Cross-check current ACadSharp and LibreDWG report families against existing libdxfrw owners
Refine the optional composed peer-comparison recipe without adding routine validation

sources.revision: cadkit-dwg docs.rs 0.3.3 and cadkit-dxf crates.io/docs.rs 0.3.3, published 2026-10-16; mutable GitHub main reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The published DWG reader API documents a native view retaining decoded object fields and raw bytes plus a separate projection into a neutral model. The repository README marks AC1012/R13 untested and documents DXF output but no DWG writer. The provenance ledger names ODA v5.4.1 and ACadSharp as knowledge/sample sources, attributes the R2007 LZ77/container route to ACadSharp, and describes an ACadSharp-derived public sample corpus. Repository changelog currently ends at 0.2.1 while package artifacts are 0.3.3.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Project declarations and package documentation only. The package-to-source commit, crate checksum and runtime behavior were not bound or executed. The route is not an independent normative authority, AC1012 qualification, DWG writer, ACIS/B-rep oracle, or support result.

sources.revision: Current mutable issue board, release list and version/direction matrix reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: The visible issue families include route- and version-specific reports about writer field/length loss, recursive parser depth, locale-sensitive codepage lookup, compound POLYLINE/VERTEX handling, 3DSOLID/REGION output omission, AC1032 INSERT loss and native rejection. They map to existing local parser-hardening, EED/XDATA, codepage, compound-record, modeler-loss-accounting and native-writer owners.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Issue-board reports and project matrices, not verified behavior of every current package or libdxfrw. No reporter file was fetched and no peer binary was run.

sources.revision: 0.14.1 NEWS, manual, and mutable open-issue index reviewed 2026-10-19
sources.observed: NEWS and manual disclose continuing version/direction limits alongside regression and security fixes; issue reports describe silent conversion incompleteness, block/entity traversal, malformed text framing, and modern AcDs/SAB loss. Existing local owners already cover the corresponding output closure, graph disposition, parser/text safety and carrier association questions.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Release documentation and version-scoped issue reports only. They do not establish current-master runtime behavior or a corresponding libdxfrw defect.

sources.revision: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, current authoritative reference named by repository instructions
sources.observed: The specification remains the byte-layout authority. Independent implementations may share this document, sample corpora or implementation lineage, so matching behavior corroborates implementation hypotheses but does not replace spec resolution.
sources.evidenceCeiling: Normative byte-layout reference for DWG fields, not a semantic ACIS kernel or native application acceptance result. No new byte-layout disagreement was tested in this research-only pass.

localEvidence: The plan already contains a 139-finding / 77-subplan route-aware evidence ledger and maps the refreshed ACadSharp/LibreDWG report families to existing local owners.
The existing PAR-07/S8 route ledger separates source identity, native parse/capture, owner/reference closure, emitted carrier, independent reopen, semantic interpretation and consumer acceptance.

The useful delta is to require separate native/raw and neutral-projection dispositions when a candidate exposes both, and to bind package artifacts to immutable source/provenance before any optional composed run.
Existing generated local tests remain the per-slice validation path; optional peers and native applications remain at existing composed checkpoints.

assessment.planImpact: Refines the existing PAR-07/S8 optional peer recipe: exact package/source/toolchain/corpus binding; separate raw/native decode, neutral projection, output, strict reopen, semantic and native outcomes; no AC1012 eligibility from a matrix claim; no per-slice peer runtime. No new local finding or support claim.

method.kind: Read-only internet primary-source review and local plan audit
method.limitations: Current candidate package docs and mutable repository documentation disagree in version and AC1012 qualification; package-to-source provenance remains unbound. Peer issues are self-reported, version-scoped and not local reproductions. No source file or drawing payload was inspected or executed.
